# WhisperX source provenance

`whisperx/` is a project-owned copy of the exact package imported from the existing reference environment: `E:\whisperX\.venv\Lib\site-packages\whisperx`, WhisperX 3.8.6. Its package assets are included; bytecode caches are excluded. `LICENSE` preserves the upstream BSD-2-Clause notice.

The separate checkout at `E:\whisperX\pyproject.toml` declares 3.8.7rc1. The runtime reference remains the installed 3.8.6 package; its API and dependency versions are recorded in `docs/ENGINE_INTEGRATION.md` and the pinned runtime lock.
